extracted.name: Veggie Indian-style burger
extracted.description: Add Indian flavours to veggie burgers with raita, mango chutney, coriander and Bombay mix for a fruity and crunchy twist. They're perfect for summer dining
instruction_lines: Cook the vegetarian bean burgers following pack instructions. Finely chop the red onion, cucumber, tomato and coriander and mix together in a bowl. Lightly toast the burger buns. Divide the raita, burgers, mango chutney, the tomato, onion and cucumber salad and Bombay mix between each bun.
